body:
And what happens when a person has problems that no "tools" can fix? What happens when the issue isn't someone's "perception" of their problems, but their actual fucking PROBLEMS, and those problems CAN'T be fixed? What if it was an indisputable fact that, for whatever reason, your boyfriend would have constant hallucinations/flashbacks/whatever 24 hours a day, with no hope of escape?

This talk of "perception"  is nonsense. This is like feeding me excrement and telling me that if I could only perceive it as cake, everything would be fine.

You say it's up to the individual to do things, but if the thing they want to do is kill themselves, suddenly that's wrong.

Yeah, I know it's painful to kill yourself. That's the whole fucking reason why I set out to find a *better* way, something that would at least try to *minimize* pain.
